Class OmieFaultClassifier

Namespace
NuvTools.Payment.Omie.ApiClient
Assembly
NuvTools.Payment.Omie.ApiClient.dll

Classifies Omie failure messages so callers can react programmatically (e.g. switch an OS create to an update when the integration code already exists) instead of string-matching Omie text themselves. This component surfaces faults as failed IResult (it deliberately does not throw — see the comment on OmieApiClient._staticClient), so the markers live here in one place.

VERIFY (Omie test app): confirm the exact faultstring wording for the duplicate-integration-code and not-found cases against the current Omie responses and adjust the markers below if needed.

DescribeThrottle(string?)

A message for the end user about a throttled call, preserving the wait Omie reported when there is one. Telling someone to wait is a different instruction from telling them to fix something, which is why the refusal is worth distinguishing.

IsMissingOrderIdentification(string?)

True when AlterarOS refused the change claiming the OS identification tags were not informed. Intermittent: the same body, byte for byte, has been accepted and refused by Omie minutes apart. Retrying later is the only remedy — but not immediately, since an identical repeated call is what Omie punishes as redundant consumption.

IsThrottled(string?)

True when Omie refused the call to control consumption rather than because of the request itself — either a redundant call (the same parameters again within about a minute) or an app key temporarily blocked for excessive calls. Neither is fixed by changing the request: only by waiting.
